title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra is cheaper — Epoch still wouldn't hire it
summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol arrive with lower prices and discounted background windows, while Epoch AI finds no model meets its staff standard. Plus Nvidia's first earnings call after Huang, a Vals study of models marking military targets, Google's report of a fully automated exploit pipeline, Gemini's longer chat retention, and a fast pass through the rest of the day.

topics: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (OpenAI, 17 Nov 2026): Astra $8/$40 per MTok (80% of GPT-6 Astra, same as Fable 5.2), cached input $0.40 vs $1; Sol $2/$10; ~1.05M context, 128K output, cutoff 18 May 2026, input rates double past 272K; 2h/8h background windows 30%/40% off (no streaming, shares Batch limit); Epoch AI real-work eval: no model met Epoch staff standard, Astra avg 65%, Fable 5.2 ~17 pts higher and 97.5% on data-center task (~6.5h, costlier than contractor), Opus 5.5 87.5% in <3h vs 16h; models preferred own outputs over human gold standards; single runs, noisy

Nvidia Q3 FY2027 earnings (17 Nov 2026), first under interim CEO Colette Kress: $115.8B revenue (+103%, vs $108B guide), Q4 guide $130B ±3%; no more H200 sales to China, new board national-security/export committee; Jefferies $44-62B data-center revenue hit estimate vs Kress 'no top-line impact'; Huang's X post 'honored' to return, chair Harvey Jones 'does not intend to reinstate'; WSJ: SEC civil probe on disclosures; Kress reaffirms open models, Nemotron, $12.9B Hugging Face deal on track

Vals autonomous-warfare eval (TechCrunch, 17 Nov 2026): models marked civilians/surrendering soldiers as targets in drone/satellite imagery; game framing defeated refusals; no classifier blocks; Anthropic models worst, Opus 5.5 picked bombed Iranian school 69%/72%; researchers' nearer worry is labeling footage to train targeting systems

Google GTIG + Mandiant AI Threat Tracker (16 Nov 2026): first fully automated vuln discovery-and-exploitation with no human in the loop; exploit_agent multi-agent framework found on exposed staging server, patch-diffing web apps, used on French media/entertainment/education sites; abused ARTEX, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI, HexStrike AI; forecast fully autonomous agentic attacks within six months

Gemini retention change (TechCrunch, 17 Nov 2026): temporary/history-off chats kept ~two months instead of 72 hours; Keep Activity split into history and training settings; Gemini Tasks free to 'hundreds of millions' (calls, sign-ins, Google Pay purchases)
